purpose: Validate convex normal-fibre distances, dual lower values, and multidirectional folding examples.
source_model: Opposite scalar negative-halfline observations identify a dense nuisance direction; d source-invisible directions remain.
target_model: Dense orthogonal action and parameter transforms of (u_+,(-u)_+) or u_+; target response depends on all d invisible coordinates.
interpretation: Fixed theorem controls, not statistical benchmarks or external replication. Orthogonal transforms preserve the exact d-dimensional families. Floating-point diagnostics are not interval-certified.
